svg.aria-label: Animation in three steps, idealized. Chaining: Gemma, Llama and Qwen each hold the same layout of subjects, rotated and scaled; composing the Gemma to Llama and Llama to Qwen rotations lands where the direct Gemma to Qwen rotation does, keeping a median 99 percent of its transfer accuracy. Compression: keeping only 16 principal components flattens every layout, and 256 components keep a median 74 percent of the transfer accuracy. Shared space: both results are consistent with LLMs being rotated views of one shared, lower-dimensional space.
